name: SCB X Public Company Limited
summary: SCB X Public Company Limited engages in the banking, consumer and digital finance, and platform and technology businesses in Thailand and internationally. It operates through Corporate, SME, Retail, and Others segments. The company offers commercial banking and associated financial management services; CardX for credit and personal loans; AutoX for vehicle title loans; MONIX for digital lending through the FINNIX app; ABACUS Digital for digital lending through the Money Thunder app; Alpha X for luxury financing services; InnovestX, an integrated investing platform; SCB 10X, a technology investment arm; Token X, an initial coin offering portal; and Point X, a point redemption service.
